blocks.title: Summary
blocks.standfirst: Water damage is the costliest routine claim, and automatic shut-off cuts it.

paragraphs: Water damage is the most common insurance claim in multifamily buildings, averaging $24,000 per claim [S2].
In a field study of 1,200 units, automatic shut-off valves cut the average claim by 71% [S3]; Tidewell's pilot recorded no claim over $5,000 across 42 buildings [S1].
